# Simple note login

print('simple_note_login:', sn_login)
sn_token = sn_login.get('access_token')

# Venmo login
v_login = apis.venmo.login(username='cod.smith@gmail.com', password=pw['venmo'])
print('venmo_login:', v_login)
venmo_token = v_login.get('access_token')

# Search for notes likely related to work dinner
# We'll paginate all results for query='Work Dinner' (and maybe fallback later)

def fetch_all_notes(query):
    all_notes = []
    page=0
    while True:
        res = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=sn_token, query=query, page_index=page, page_limit=20, sort_by='-updated_at')
        print(f'notes_page query={query} page={page}:', res)
        if not res:
            break
        notes = res.get('notes', []) if isinstance(res, dict) else []
        # Some APIs return list directly; handle gracefully
        if isinstance(res, list):
            notes = res
        if not notes:
            break
        all_notes.extend(notes)
        page += 1
        if page>50:
            break
    return all_notes

notes_work_dinner = fetch_all_notes('Work Dinner')
notes_dinner = fetch_all_notes('dinner')
print('count Work Dinner notes:', len(notes_work_dinner))
print('count dinner notes:', len(notes_dinner))

# Print note ids and titles for inspection
for n in notes_work_dinner[:10]:
    print('WD note:', n.get('note_id'), n.get('title'), n.get('updated_at'))
for n in notes_dinner[:10]:
    print('Dinner note:', n.get('note_id'), n.get('title'), n.get('updated_at'))

# Determine yesterday and today
now = datetime.now()
yesterday = (now - timedelta(days=1)).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
today = now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
